title: Aye Mere laal Asghar
body:
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
Maa Kehti Hai Yeh Rokar, Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
1-Halmin Ki Sada Sunkar Jhoole Se Wo Girjaana
Aakho'n Me Hai Wo Manzar
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
<<DIVIDER>>
2-Ankho,n Me Tera Chehra Phirta Hai Mere Beta
Bechain Hai Ye Maadar
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
<<DIVIDER>>
3-Wo Teere Sitam Khaake Dam Todhna Haatho,n Par
Zakhmi Hai Dil E Sarwar as
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
<<DIVIDER>>
4-Chehre Pa Malaa Shaey as Ne Besheer Lahoo Tera
Pur Dard Hai Ye Manzar
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
<<DIVIDER>>
5-Asghar Tera Jhoola Bhi Aada Ne Hai Jalaya
Kaise Jiyegi Maadar
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as.
<<DIVIDER>>
6-Sughra Jo Tumhe Pooche Kia Usko Bataungi
Marjae Na Wo Muztar
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as.
<<DIVIDER>>
7- Arif Ko Bhi Bulalo Hamraah Asghri Ke
Asghar Tumhare Dar Par
<<MINI>>
Aey Mere Laal Asghar as
